title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations. However, dense patch representations expose a redundant interface to downstream predictors, which must implicitly infer spatial organization and temporal correspondence, presenting three challenges. First, object information is distributed across patches, forcing each downstream predictor to redundantly recover object structure that could otherwise be reused across tasks before modeling interactions. Second, the lack of explicit entity correspondence across time makes historical transitions expensive, restricting the predictor's flexibility in utilizing context. Third, without explicit transport structure, existing JEPA models typically use pointwise l1/l2 distances, which are insensitive to spatial displacement when predicted and goal supports are largely disjoint. translated_title: Slot-JEPA：面向潜在世界模型的对象结构化预测接口
translated_abstract: 作为一种典型的潜在世界模型，联合嵌入预测架构提供了强大的语义表示能力。然而，密集的图像块表示向下游预测器暴露了一个冗余的接口，预测器必须隐式地推断空间组织和时间对应关系，这带来了三个挑战。第一，物体信息分散在各个图像块之间，迫使每个下游预测器在建模交互之前冗余地恢复本可以在任务间复用的物体结构。第二，缺乏跨时间的显式实体对应关系使得历史状态转换的建模代价高昂，限制了预测器利用上下文的灵活性。第三，由于缺乏显式的传输结构，现有的JEPA模型通常使用逐点的l1/l2距离，当预测支持集与目标支持集大部分不重叠时，这些距离对空间位移不敏感。我们提出了基于槽的联合嵌入预测架构……
tldr: 该论文提出Slot-JEPA，通过基于槽的对象结构化表示为潜在世界模型构建更高效的对象级预测接口，解决了JEPA中密集图像块表示的冗余性、时间对应关系缺失以及空间位移度量不敏感这三大问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Slot-JEPA, which introduces object-structured slot-based prediction interfaces for latent world models to address the redundancy of dense patch representations, the lack of explicit temporal entity correspondence, and the insensitivity of pointwise distances to spatial displacement in JEPAs.
